name: Font-rubí (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with the yellow wall and open towers of the arms disposed as a fess across the central third.
history: The official flag of Font-rubí is a heraldic flag of the municipal arms: an oblong flag of 2:3, dark blue, with the yellow wall and open towers of the arms disposed as a fess of the full length of the cloth occupying the central third, the towers rising 1/9 above the wall.

features.role: wall with two open towers disposed as a fess across the central third
